## ENDPOINTS

### A2A Gateway (this server)
- POST /tasks — Send task to AAA gateway
- GET /tasks/{taskId} — Get task status
- GET /tasks/{taskId}/stream — Stream task progress
- POST /tasks/{taskId}/cancel — Cancel task
- GET /health — Gateway health check
- GET /.well-known/agent-card.json — A2A agent card

### MCP Gateway (mcp.arif-fazil.com)
- POST /mcp — MCP JSON-RPC endpoint (canonical entry)
- GET /health — MCP health check
- GET /.well-known/mcp/server.json — MCP server discovery

### Constitutional Kernel (arifos.arif-fazil.com)
- POST /mcp — arifOS kernel MCP endpoint
- GET /health — Kernel health
- GET /wiki — Constitutional doctrine wiki
- GET /api/status — Kernel status
- GET /api/federation-probe — Federation health probe
